title: Anna's Busy Week
text:
Anna has a busy week. On Monday she goes to school. On Tuesday she plays football with her friends. On Wednesday she visits her grandmother.

On Thursday, she does not go to school because it is a holiday. On Friday she cooks dinner for her family. On Saturday and Sunday she relaxes at home and reads her favourite books.

questions.text: What does Anna do on Tuesday?
options: She plays football with her friends.
She cooks dinner for her family.

questions.text: On which day does Anna cook dinner for her family?
How does Anna probably feel on Saturday and Sunday?
What kind of person is Anna most likely to be?
options: a lazy person who never goes out
a person who does not like her family
a person who works every day

vocabulary.definition: having a lot of things to do
a day when people do not go to work or school

paragraph_translations: Anna ma zajęty tydzień. W poniedziałek chodzi do szkoły. We wtorek gra w piłkę nożną z przyjaciółmi. W środę odwiedza babcię.
W czwartek nie idzie do szkoły, ponieważ jest święto. W piątek gotuje obiad dla rodziny. W sobotę i niedzielę odpoczywa w domu i czyta swoje ulubione książki.
